newsitem.title: USA: Anchor Gaming mulling Colorado options.
newsitem.headline: Anchor Gaming mulling Colorado options.

text.p: Anchor Gaming said Thursday that although it has written down assets related to an expansion project in Colorado, it has not abandoned the concept of an expansion in Colorado and will continue to re-evaluate its options.
Anchor Gaming reported earnings for the fourth quarter ended June 30 of $0.78 a share, compared to $0.54 a share the previous fourth quarter.
Included in the 1997 fourth quarter results was a project costs write-down of $0.10 a share for it proposed addition of a new casino across the street from the Colorado Central Station Casino.
In November, the company had said it was re-evaluating the scope and nature of the proposed addition.
According to the gaming company, the project costs were specifically related to architectural fees, building design costs, and deferred rent that were determined to have no future benefit.
Anchor said the expenses did not qualify as an extraordinary item for financial reporting purposes.
